integrity: A fully specified proof and reproducible standalone exact-arithmetic checker are included. Same-model review is not independent verification; equivalence to unlocated older polyphase-array literature remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Exact minimum for odd finite phase alphabets is not computed; no conclusion for higher-dimensional cubes, nonunit coefficient magnitudes, or sampling groups with order two.
title: Exact fourth-moment rigidity of the eight-mode cubic Fourier aperture
